items.title: Upload certified bachelor's certificate and transcript
items.quote: Please upload a certified copy of your bachelor's certificate and your final transcript to the applicant portal no later than 14 December 2026.
items.computation: The letter prints a fixed calendar date for this task: 14 December 2026. This is a deadline set by a private institution (not a public authority), so no statutory deemed-delivery or §193 BGB weekend/holiday extension applies unless the letter itself shifts it, which it does not. 14 December 2026 falls on a Monday, so no weekend adjustment would be needed in any case. The due date is therefore the date as printed.

warnings: The offer is conditional and will automatically lapse if the certified documents are not received via the applicant portal by 14 December 2026 — no second reminder is promised.
